The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''28,930 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''7,523 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, [[Je'daii Master|Master]] [[Shall Mar]] of the [[Je'daii Order]] wrote the book ''[[A Life in Balance]]''.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
